name: Tubeless
subtitle: Ad-free videos on iPhone and iPad
description: Tubeless for iPhone and iPad: no ads, background play, picture-in-picture and downloads, with or without a Google account. Open source (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

apps.name: Tubeless
apps.subtitle: Ad-free videos on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Tubeless plays videos without ads.

- Background play and picture-in-picture
- Downloads that keep working offline
- Sign in to your YouTube account for your own Home, subscriptions and history, or use it with no account
- SponsorBlock, DeArrow and dislike counts

Based on Tubeless. Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
